remarks: Welcome to COVE, one of Stamford's most desirable water communities. This turn-key multifamily home comes with two units, one on each level. Ground Floor unit is currently used as a 2BD/1BR unit and it comes with its own inside access to the lower level for additional storage and laundry/mechanicals access. It has a nice size foyer and even a walk-in closet in the bedroom. The upstairs unit has a spacious kitchen, living room, 1BD/1BR layout and walks out onto the private deck with exit to the beautiful large shared fully fenced backyard ready for everyone's enjoyment. The upstairs unit utilizes access to the walk-up attic allowing for an extra storage. It has its own washer/dryer set up in the shared basement area accessible through the hatch in the back. Both units enjoy their own separate driveways for a total of four cars, providing for ample off-street parking. NEWER roof, siding, hot water heaters (2021) as well as sump pump. Each unit has its own washer/dryer hookups. Easy walk to Cove Beach park as well as Chelsea Piers. Just a short drive to I-95, minutes to Darien, Downtown Stamford's shops and restaurants as well as Cummings and West Beach Parks.
